text:
```yaml
name: OpenSSF Scorecard

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  scorecard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify SPDX license in package.json
        run: |
          echo "Checking license field in package.json files..."
          find . -name package.json -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            license=$(jq -r '.license' "$file")
            if [ "$license" != "MIT" ]; then
              echo "❌ $file has license $license"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ All package.json files have license MIT"

      - name: Run OpenSSF Scorecard
        uses: ossf/scorecard-action@v1
        with:
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          results_file: scorecard.json
          results_format: json
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Commit scorecard results
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add scorecard.json
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: update OpenSSF Scorecard results"
            git push
          else
            echo "No changes to commit."
          fi
```
